/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.title: The Inter emblem in diamonds
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.text: A championship ring made for the whole Inter Milan squad after the club's twentieth league title: the emblem in diamonds on a deep blue ground, crowned with rose-gold stars.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.title: The emblem, face on
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.text: Seen straight on, the emblem sits in its circle of stars, between the words I Nerazzurri above and Forza Inter below.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p1.title: Campione on the band
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p1.text: Tilted, the ring shows its layers: the paved head, the black and blue border, then the band engraved with Campione d'Italia above the diamond-set shoulders.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.title: Tier upon tier
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.text: From this angle the head rises tier upon tier, and the shoulder opens onto baguette diamonds around the polished rose-gold 20.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.title: The other side, in red
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.text: On the opposite side, a red line runs along the engraved Internazionale Milano, carrying the colours of the flag around the head.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.title: Mirrored on black
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.text: Set on a black mirror, the ring is reflected whole: the emblem, the stars, the plaques of I Nerazzurri and Forza Inter.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.title: Green beside the stars
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.text: Close up, a fine green line separates the engraved band from the diamond tiers, where rose-gold stars sit between the stones.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.title: On the house's velvet
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.text: The ring rests on black velvet printed with the Berete Jewellers name in rose gold, the emblem turned towards the light.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.title: From below, the open shank
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.text: From below, the shank reveals its full width of pavé, while Forza Inter and the colours of the Italian flag run around the top.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.title: Profile on velvet
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.text: In profile on black velvet, the ring shows its height: the tiers of the head, the green line of the flag, and the BRT mark in rose gold on the shoulder.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/v1.title: The whole squad, on film
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/v1.text: The film opens on the two emblems, Berete Jewellers and Inter, then glides slowly between the rings of the series, set out row after row.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.title: Diamonds held in claws
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.text: Front view on black velvet: the diamonds of the emblem rise above the blue, each held by fine white-gold claws.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p1.title: I Nerazzurri
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p1.text: At the top of the head, I Nerazzurri is engraved on a polished plaque above the colours of the flag; beneath, the inside of the band is mirror-polished.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.title: The emblem, stone by stone
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.text: The emblem is set in diamonds on a blue ground, inside a ring of stars: one star and one diamond for each of the club's twenty league titles.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.title: Stars and shirt stripes
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.text: Rose-gold stars alternate with diamonds, and beyond them black, blue, black, blue: the stripes of the Inter shirt run all around the emblem.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.title: Raised in the light
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.text: In raking light, each tier of the head reads clearly: the emblem raised above the blue, the circle of stars, the shirt stripes, then a row of larger diamonds.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.title: Campione d'Italia
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.text: Inter Milan Campione d'Italia is written around the ring in polished letters; a discreet hinge sits between Milano and Campione.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p1.title: Forza Inter
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p1.text: Above the flag, the cry of the supporters: Forza Inter, engraved on a polished plaque over the green, white and red of Italy.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p1.title: The Serie A logo
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p1.text: On the shoulder, the logo of the Serie A with the number 20 added to it, in polished rose gold over a field of baguette diamonds.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.title: The 20, in profile
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.text: Turned to the side, the polished rose gold of the 20 catches the light, while the baguettes behind it are set in tight rows.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.title: Rose gold on baguettes
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.text: Closer still, the logo stands in relief above rows of baguette diamonds, framed by a border of round pavé that follows the curve of the shoulder.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.title: A name and a number
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.text: The opposite shoulder carries a name and a number in polished rose gold, set over baguette diamonds beneath the engraved Internazionale Milano.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.title: The shoulder, in full
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.text: Seen from the side, the shoulder flares out in pavé around its field of baguettes, and the band narrows to polished metal underneath.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.title: The secret within
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.text: The top lifts off and reveals the cup hidden underneath, sculpted in yellow gold and set in a polished white-gold frame.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.title: Cup and top together
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.text: With the top lifted, the hidden cup stands in the foreground while the top, now a pendant with its diamond bail, waits behind.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.title: Beneath the top
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.text: The underside of the top is polished smooth, with a bail that folds flat into it; behind, the cup waits in the open ring.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.title: Ring and pendant
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.text: Separated, the ring keeps its cup while the top hangs from its bail, ready to be worn on its own as a pendant.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.title: A bail set with diamonds
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p0.text: Raised on its bail, the top becomes a pendant; the bail is set with diamonds, and the cup rests in the foreground.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.title: Beyond a ring
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.text: The top can also be worn on its own, as a pendant: the emblem and its stars hang from a bail paved with diamonds.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.title: The pendant, at an angle
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p4.text: At an angle, the pendant shows its open bail in polished white gold and the edge of the head, still engraved with Forza Inter.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p1.title: Signed inside
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p1.text: Inside the band, the BRT mark and the outline of its diamond stand in relief on the mirror-polished metal.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p1.title: The BRT mark
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p1.text: On the side of the ring, the BRT mark in rose gold rises over baguette diamonds, beneath the engraved Internazionale Milano and its red line.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.title: Rings for the whole squad
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.text: A series of rings made for the whole squad, lined up on white: the same emblem, the same stars, ring after ring.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.title: One ring steps forward
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.text: One ring stands forward, Forza Inter at its base, while the rest of the series dissolves into points of light behind it.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.title: Among the series
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.text: Surrounded by the others, each ring carries the same emblem, the same circle of rose-gold stars and the colours of the flag along the band.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.title: Rows on a dark ground
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.text: On a dark surface, the rings recede in rows; in front, the emblem's diamonds and the rose-gold stars come into focus.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.title: The squad, assembled
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p5.text: Set out in even rows, the rings cast long shadows, like a squad lined up before a match.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p3.title: On the hand
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p3.text: Worn on a closed hand, the ring spans the finger, its green and blue lines catching the light.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.title: Checked before the handover
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.text: Held in a white glove with its top removed, the ring shows the sculpted cup in its polished frame.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.title: The emblem in the glove
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.text: In the white glove, the emblem is turned to the light: diamonds, rose-gold stars and blue ground, ready to be handed over.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.title: The side, inspected
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.text: Turned on its side, the ring shows Internazionale Milano and, on the shoulder, the name and number set over baguettes.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.title: The pendant in hand
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p6.text: Held in a black glove, the top worn as a pendant shows its emblem in diamonds and its paved bail.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p2.title: The case, lettered in gold
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p2.text: The case carries Campione d'Italia and the season of the title in gold letters, above the BRT mark of the house.

/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p2.title: In its case
/media/hd/campione-d-italia-2023-2024/p2.text: Inside the dark case, the ring sits upright on its stand, the emblem facing out beneath the gold lettering.

/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p07.title: Two initials, one ampersand
/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p07.text: Two bold initials joined by an ampersand, paved with diamonds and outlined in polished white gold, hanging from a wide Cuban chain.

/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p01.title: On the bust
/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p01.text: On a black bust, the wide Cuban chain lies flat around the neck and brings the initials to rest at the centre of the chest.

/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/v02.title: In its case, on film
/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/v02.text: The film moves slowly over the chain and pendant laid in their black Berete Jewellers case, the diamonds flashing as the angle changes.

/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p03.title: The depth of the letters
/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p03.text: Seen from the side, each letter is built in relief: a domed border of pavé, then the initial itself, raised and outlined in polished metal.

/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p05.title: The D, close up
/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p05.text: Within the outline of the D, marquise and pear diamonds mix with touches of baguettes, around a centre paved with round stones.

/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p04.title: The ampersand
/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p04.text: The ampersand curls between the two letters, set with marquise and pear diamonds, while baguettes punctuate the E.

/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p02.title: Stone against stone
/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p02.text: Very close, fine beads of metal hold each round diamond of the pavé, beside the larger marquise cuts along the edge.

/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p06.title: The bail, through the chain
/media/hd/ampersand-initials-pendant/p06.text: Paved with diamonds, with a baguette at its foot, the bail passes through the links of the Cuban chain.

/media/hd/oval-eternity-band/p02.webp.title: Oval diamonds, all around
/media/hd/oval-eternity-band/p02.webp.text: An eternity band in white gold tones, set all the way around with oval diamonds in claw settings, the circle unbroken from every side.

/media/hd/oval-eternity-band/p01.webp.title: A row of ovals
/media/hd/oval-eternity-band/p01.webp.text: Face on, the ovals sit lengthwise along the finger, held by slim claws and almost touching one another.

/media/hd/oval-eternity-band/p03.webp.title: Open beneath each stone
/media/hd/oval-eternity-band/p03.webp.text: From the side, the band shows an opening beneath every diamond, letting light reach the stones from below.

/media/hd/oval-eternity-band/p04.webp.title: The BRT mark inside
/media/hd/oval-eternity-band/p04.webp.text: Inside, the polished band carries the engraved BRT mark, between the openings that sit beneath the diamonds.

/media/pieces/radja-nainggolan-iced-watc.title: On Radja Nainggolan's wrist
/media/pieces/radja-nainggolan-iced-watc.text: Radja Nainggolan's iced watch on his wrist: a dial paved with diamonds, a set bezel, and a bracelet set link by link.

/media/hd/sirius/p27.webp.title: Sirius, chain and nameplate
/media/hd/sirius/p27.webp.text: A chain of twisted links in rose gold carries a nameplate that spells SIRIUS in baguettes. Chain and plate are delivered together, in the trunk made for them.

/media/hd/sirius/p28.webp.title: The nameplate, face on
/media/hd/sirius/p28.webp.text: The two S of SIRIUS are drawn as dollar signs, between rows of diamond flowers. Horned masks in rose gold sit at its corners, pear-shaped diamonds at its sides.

/media/hd/sirius/p18.webp.title: A horned mask
/media/hd/sirius/p18.webp.text: Sculpted in rose gold with a soft matt finish, the mask bares its teeth beneath its horns. Its eyes are set with diamonds.

/media/hd/sirius/p17.webp.title: Twisted links, flowers and leaves
/media/hd/sirius/p17.webp.text: Polished rose-gold links twist around links paved with diamonds. Flowers of round diamonds and leaves of marquise-cut diamonds grow along the chain.

/media/hd/sirius/p16.webp.title: Where polish meets pavé
/media/hd/sirius/p16.webp.text: Up close, each paved link loops through a polished one. The marquise leaves sit in fine rose-gold bezels, beside a flower of round diamonds.

/media/hd/sirius/p22.webp.title: The clasp, signed BRT
/media/hd/sirius/p22.webp.text: At the nape, the chain closes on a paved clasp carrying the letters BRT and the diamond of the house in rose gold.

/media/hd/sirius/p02.webp.title: The Sirius trunk
/media/hd/sirius/p02.webp.text: A black trunk with studded edges, the BRT mark on one face and SIRIUS on its handle. Beside it, chain and plate rest on a red lining.

/media/hd/sirius/p23.webp.title: Baguettes in the letters
/media/hd/sirius/p23.webp.text: Inside the letters, baguettes are laid in lines and rays over a ground of round diamonds. Above and below, a row of diamond flowers runs the length of the plate.

/media/hd/sirius/p29.webp.title: The chain alone
/media/hd/sirius/p29.webp.text: Without its plate, the chain stands on its own, polished and paved links alternating, with diamond flowers spaced along its length.

/media/hd/sirius/p24.webp.title: Along the neckline
/media/hd/sirius/p24.webp.text: Seen from the side, the chain follows the curve of the neck, its flowers and marquise leaves leading down to the bail of the plate.

/media/hd/sirius/p25.webp.title: The plate's left edge
/media/hd/sirius/p25.webp.text: At an angle, the plate shows its depth: paved sides, a pear-shaped diamond in a halo at its edge, and a mask set low against the letters.

/media/hd/sirius/v03.mp4.title: The plate in motion
/media/hd/sirius/v03.mp4.text: The film travels across the plate, from the baguette letters to a horned mask, then up the bail to the chain, and closes on the BRT mark.

/media/hd/sirius/p20.webp.title: A mask above the letters
/media/hd/sirius/p20.webp.text: A mask rests on the upper edge, over the last letter. Around it, flowers of round diamonds and marquise leaves break the line of the frame.

/media/hd/sirius/p21.webp.title: Letters outlined in diamonds
/media/hd/sirius/p21.webp.text: Each letter is outlined by a fine line of round diamonds set in rose gold, which makes the baguettes inside stand out.

/media/hd/sirius/p14.webp.title: Pavé, baguettes, rose gold
/media/hd/sirius/p14.webp.text: Between the letters, rose gold shows only as thin lines: almost every surface of the plate is set with diamonds.

/media/hd/sirius/p15.webp.title: Rays of baguettes
/media/hd/sirius/p15.webp.text: In the R, lines of baguettes fan out like rays, set in white gold against the rose-gold frame.

/media/hd/sirius/p08.webp.title: A pear in the row
/media/hd/sirius/p08.webp.text: Pear-shaped diamonds interrupt the rows of diamond flowers above and below the letters, where the baguettes fan out from the centre of the plate.

/media/hd/sirius/p12.webp.title: The lower mask
/media/hd/sirius/p12.webp.text: At the lower corner, the other mask leans out from the plate, horns raised and diamond eyes catching the light.

/media/hd/sirius/p19.webp.title: A pear at the edge
/media/hd/sirius/p19.webp.text: On the right side of the plate, a pear-shaped diamond sits in a halo of round diamonds, with marquise leaves beside it.

/media/hd/sirius/p11.webp.title: The left side, in profile
/media/hd/sirius/p11.webp.text: From the left, the pear in its halo stands out from the plate like a point, with a flower and marquise leaves just beneath it.

/media/hd/sirius/p13.webp.title: The thickness of the plate
/media/hd/sirius/p13.webp.text: Even the edge is set: a band of pavé crossed by baguettes laid in a zigzag, between polished rose-gold rims.

/media/hd/sirius/p10.webp.title: Flowers along the base
/media/hd/sirius/p10.webp.text: Along the lower edge, round diamonds in rose-gold bezels form a row of flowers, with marquise leaves tucked beneath them.

/media/hd/sirius/p09.webp.title: The bail and its flower
/media/hd/sirius/p09.webp.text: The bail is a wide band of rose gold paved with diamonds, with a flower of round diamonds at its centre. Behind it, the paved links of the chain.

/media/hd/sirius/p26.webp.title: The back, engraved
/media/hd/sirius/p26.webp.text: The back of the plate is engraved with a geometric pattern and carries the BRT mark in white gold. The bail, in polished rose gold, closes with a hinged catch.

/media/hd/sirius/p05.webp.title: Turned around
/media/hd/sirius/p05.webp.text: Seen from behind, the chain shows its polished side and the plate its engraved back, with the BRT mark near its centre.

/media/hd/sirius/p01.webp.title: A mask on the trunk
/media/hd/sirius/p01.webp.text: On another face of the trunk, a horned mask in relief echoes the masks of the plate. The empty tray, lined in red, keeps the shape of chain and plate.

/media/hd/sirius/p03.webp.title: The trunk, opened
/media/hd/sirius/p03.webp.text: Opened, the trunk is lined in red, with a black panel marked BRT inside the lid. The tray beside it is framed by a black-and-white drawing of masks.

/media/hd/sirius/p04.webp.title: Laid in the tray
/media/hd/sirius/p04.webp.text: The chain lies in a circle around the plate, each in its own hollow of red lining, the BRT clasp turned toward the front.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.title: Noah Okafor's octagon
/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.text: Noah Okafor's pendant: an octagon built from baguette-cut diamonds, crossed by lines of rose gold and set with pear-shaped stones.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.title: On its tennis chains
/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.text: The pendant hangs from a paved bail on tennis chains of round diamonds, each stone held in its own claws.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.title: On the bust
/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.text: On the bust, the octagon falls at the centre of the chest, the tennis chain drawing a clean line around the neck.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.title: The bail, paved in white
/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.text: The bail is paved with round diamonds of different sizes in white gold, a smooth form that narrows toward the octagon.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.title: A herringbone of baguettes
/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.text: On the sides, baguettes are laid in a herringbone, framed by a line of round diamonds that follows every angle of the octagon.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.title: Rose gold over white
/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.text: Paved with round diamonds, the rose-gold lines pass over the white-gold herringbone, so the pendant reads in layers.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.title: Pears scattered on rose gold
/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.text: Pear-shaped diamonds in white-gold bezels are scattered across the rose-gold lines. Behind them, the centre is set with columns of baguettes.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.title: Turned every way
/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.text: The pears are turned in different directions, set among round diamonds of several sizes in the rose-gold pavé.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.title: Where the line ends
/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p0.text: A rose-gold line ends in a clean, angled cut, edged with small diamonds and finished by a pear in its bezel.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p1.title: The back, signed BRT
/media/hd/noah-okafor-octagon-pendant/p1.text: The back is engraved with a geometric pattern in white gold and carries the BRT mark in rose gold. The bail closes with a hinged catch.

/media/stories/noah-okafor-ii/03.mp4.title: The trunk opens
/media/stories/noah-okafor-ii/03.mp4.text: The lid, set with a photograph, lifts to reveal tennis chains laid side by side on black velvet, each held by small straps, under the BRT mark.

/media/stories/noah-okafor-ii/05.webp.title: The trunk on the counter
/media/stories/noah-okafor-ii/05.webp.text: Lid raised, the trunk rests on a counter with the photograph set in its frame. The tennis chains of the pendant came inside it.

/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p01.webp.title: Baguettes in every link
/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p01.webp.text: A heavy Cuban chain with angular links, each one a field of baguettes framed by round diamonds, in white and rose gold tones that alternate.

/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p05.webp.title: Face on
/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p05.webp.text: From the front, the links lie flat and tight, white and rose taking turns all the way around the neck.

/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p03.webp.title: At an angle
/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p03.webp.text: At an angle, the chain shows its weight: the links stand thick and squared, and the light runs along the baguettes.

/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p02.webp.title: The clasp at the nape
/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p02.webp.text: Seen from the side, the chain closes at the back of the neck on its domed, paved clasp, as wide as the links.

/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p08.webp.title: White, then rose
/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p08.webp.text: Laid flat, the links show their pattern: each one framed in round diamonds, the frames turning white and rose in turn.

/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p07.webp.title: Fields of baguettes
/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p07.webp.text: At the heart of each link, a column of baguettes; around it, round diamonds held by fine claws in the colour of the link.

/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p06.webp.title: Close to the stones
/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p06.webp.text: Up close, the baguettes are set edge to edge in a channel, while the round diamonds of the frame sit slightly higher.

/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p10.webp.title: BRT on the clasp
/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p10.webp.text: The domed clasp is paved, with the letters BRT and the diamond of the house raised in rose gold, and closes with a hinged safety catch.

/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p11.webp.title: The polished back
/media/hd/baguette-cuban-chain/p11.webp.text: Turned over, the chain shows another face: every link polished smooth, in white and rose gold tones.

/media/stories/samuel-ballet/02.webp.title: Samuel Ballet's Jesus piece
/media/stories/samuel-ballet/02.webp.text: Samuel Ballet's Jesus piece: rose gold paved with diamonds, crowned with pear and marquise-cut stones. The lips are left in polished rose gold.

/media/stories/samuel-ballet/05.mp4.title: On its chain of flowers
/media/stories/samuel-ballet/05.mp4.text: A gloved hand lifts the pendant, then follows the twisted chain and its diamond flowers up to the neck.

/media/stories/samuel-ballet/01.webp.title: The face beneath the crown
/media/stories/samuel-ballet/01.webp.text: Up close, the face is paved with round diamonds, an eye outlined in rose gold, while the crown rises above it in white gold.

/media/stories/samuel-ballet/04.webp.title: A crown of pear diamonds
/media/stories/samuel-ballet/04.webp.text: Each pear-shaped diamond of the crown is held by white-gold claws, the points turned outward in every direction.

/media/stories/samuel-ballet/06.webp.title: Flowers on the back
/media/stories/samuel-ballet/06.webp.text: The back is engraved with a pattern of flowers in rose gold, and the BRT mark stands out in relief in white gold.

/media/stories/samuel-ballet/03.mp4.title: Fastened and worn
/media/stories/samuel-ballet/03.mp4.text: The chain is fastened at the nape and the pendant settles on a black shirt; the camera then moves in close to the crown.

/media/stories/kevin-schade/03.webp.title: Kevin Schade's chain
/media/stories/kevin-schade/03.webp.text: Kevin Schade's chain of twisted links in rose gold, set with diamond flowers, lies in a circle in its box as a hand reaches for it.

/media/stories/kevin-schade/14.mp4.title: Flowers along the twist
/media/stories/kevin-schade/14.mp4.text: Held by a gloved hand on black velvet, the chain catches the light, its diamond flowers and marquise leaves sparkling along the twist.

/media/stories/kevin-schade/01.webp.title: Worn by Kevin Schade
/media/stories/kevin-schade/01.webp.text: Worn by Kevin Schade, the chain sits close around the base of the neck, bright against a black T-shirt.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: A chain of diamond butterflies
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Michy Batshuayi's chain: rose gold links set with diamonds, butterflies along its length, and at its centre a face with butterfly wings.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: The face with butterfly wings
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Glasses of baguette diamonds, a grin framed in rose gold, spiky hair traced in polished metal: the face sits between wings of baguettes edged with purple stones.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: The chain on its own
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Without its pendant, the chain falls in an even curve on the bust, a butterfly resting on each side of the neck.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: A butterfly along the links
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Seen from the side, a diamond butterfly rides the chain, its wing tips hung with purple pear-shaped stones in rose gold bezels.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: Close over the pendant
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: The film travels slowly across the pendant: the baguettes of a wing, the grin, the lower butterfly with its pear diamond, then up to the bail.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: In a gloved hand
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Held in a black glove, the pendant tilts gently and light runs across the rows of baguettes in its wings.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: Glasses of baguettes
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: The glasses are set with baguette diamonds inside a fine pavé rim of white gold; below, the grin's baguettes sit in a rose gold frame.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: Pavé in relief
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Under the grin, raised forms paved with round diamonds stand above a second layer of pavé, giving the face its depth.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: The pear diamond
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: At the heart of the lower butterfly, a large pear-shaped diamond is held by rose gold claws, between marquises and purple stones in bezels.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: Lines of the face
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Rose gold lines draw the hair in sharp points, while a white gold grid divides the pavé of the face into small panels.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: Where the wing meets the face
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: The wing's baguettes and purple stones meet the edge of the face, outlined by a single curve of polished rose gold.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: A wing of baguettes
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Each wing holds rows of baguette diamonds within borders of round pavé, scattered with purple pear-shaped and round stones.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: Purple stones in bezels
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Every purple stone sits in its own rose gold bezel, set among the round diamonds at the tip of the wing.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: The paved bail
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: The wide bail is paved on its face with round diamonds of varying sizes, its inside left in polished rose gold.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: A butterfly on the chain
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Its veined wings are paved with diamonds; a marquise, a round and a pear diamond form the body, with purple drops along the edges.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: Links wrapped in pavé
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Polished rose gold links are wrapped by bands of paved diamonds, with small sprays of marquise diamonds set like leaves.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: Polish and pavé
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Close up, the bright rose gold of each link shows between the paved bands, catching the light where the metal curves.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: The chain from behind
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: From the back, the links show their polished rose gold, and the pendant reveals an engraved back with the BRT mark at its centre.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: The engraved back
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: The back of the pendant is engraved in rose gold with the face drawn again and again around the BRT mark; above, the hinged bail and its catch.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: Worn close to the neck
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Worn, the chain sits close around the neck and the pendant rests high on the chest, its wings spread wide.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: On black cotton
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Against black cotton, the rose gold and the white diamonds stand out, and the butterflies of the chain frame the pendant on either side.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: In daylight
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: In soft daylight, the baguettes of the wings turn bright white while the links keep a warm rose gold tone.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: From a distance
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Seen from a distance, the chain and pendant form a single line of light from the collar down to the chest.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: At the table
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: When seated, the pendant lies flat against the chest and the chain follows the line of the collar.

/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.title: Worn, in motion
/media/hd/michy-batshuayi-butterfly-chai.text: Filmed close in low light, the pendant sways on the chest and its diamonds flash with every movement.

/media/stories/michy-batshuayi/10.mp4.title: In the making
/media/stories/michy-batshuayi/10.mp4.text: At the workbench, the back takes its engraving, a bare rose gold butterfly awaits its stones and the diamonds are set one by one; then, the finished pendant.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p09.webp.title: Round links and crosses
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p09.webp.text: A chain of round rose gold links, each one paved with diamonds and joined to the next by a cross of baguettes.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p01.webp.title: Two crosses, two sizes
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p01.webp.text: Pairs of paved links meet at a small cross of baguettes framed in rose gold; a longer cross, set with larger baguettes, joins one pair to the next.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p02.webp.title: A figure of eight
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p02.webp.text: Joined at their centre by the small cross, two round links form a figure of eight, paved all around with round diamonds.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/14-p05.we.title: The rhythm of the chain
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/14-p05.we.text: Along the chain, small rose gold crosses and long crosses of baguettes alternate between the paved links.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p04.webp.title: Baguettes held by claws
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p04.webp.text: On the long crosses, each baguette is held at its corners by fine claws, the stones set end to end along the arms.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/14-p10.we.title: Facets in rows
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/14-p10.we.text: Close up, the long facets of the baguettes line up along the cross, against the soft relief of the pavé behind.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p07.webp.title: Laid flat
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p07.webp.text: Laid flat, the chain keeps its crosses aligned, while the round links turn slightly to catch the light.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p05.webp.title: The front of the chain
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p05.webp.text: At the front, a pair of links sits between long crosses of baguettes, the small rose gold cross at its centre.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/14-p06.we.title: Rounded pavé
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/14-p06.we.text: The links are fully rounded, paved over their top and sides so that the diamonds follow the curve of the metal.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p12.webp.title: In profile
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p12.webp.text: Seen low and close, the long cross stands raised above the links, while the small cross keeps its polished rose gold frame.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p10.webp.title: The oval clasp
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p10.webp.text: The oval clasp is paved too: a domed border of round diamonds around a field of baguettes, with the BRT mark in rose gold.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p11.webp.title: The BRT mark in relief
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p11.webp.text: From the side, the letters BRT and the outline of a diamond stand in relief above the baguettes, between polished rose gold tabs.

/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p06.webp.title: At the nape
/media/hd/cross-infinity-chain/p06.webp.text: On the bust, the clasp sits at the back of the neck, with the paved links and crosses continuing on either side.

/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p10.w.title: A panther and a champion's belt
/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p10.w.text: Created for Lasana Keita: a panther paved with diamonds, its jaws open, grips a champion's belt of yellow gold plates on a glossy black band.

/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p08.w.title: The open jaws
/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p08.w.text: From three-quarters, the jaws open wide in polished white gold, the fangs bared above the name LASANA on the belt.

/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/v03.m.title: Turning in the hand
/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/v03.m.text: Held by its bail in a black glove, the pendant turns slowly, and light moves across the pavé of the panther and the gold plates of the belt.

/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/08-v0.title: An earlier stage
/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/08-v0.text: In an open hand, the pendant turns from front to back: the panther already paved, the belt still plain metal traced with fine lines, the back carved with stars.

/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p05.w.title: A marquise eye
/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p05.w.text: The eye is a marquise diamond in a fine white gold bezel; polished fangs and a dark nose break the pavé of the head.

/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p07.w.title: The head from above
/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p07.w.text: From above, round diamonds cover the brow and ears in close rows, the marquise eyes framed in polished metal.

/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p04.w.title: The champion's plate
/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p04.w.text: The centre plate of the belt carries the name LASANA and the words MMA CHAMPION, framed by engraved arabesques and small set diamonds.

/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p06.w.title: Claws on the belt
/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p06.w.text: A paw paved with diamonds closes over a side plate, its claws polished black against the yellow gold.

/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p09.w.title: The back, carved with stars
/media/hd/panther-champion-pendant/p09.w.text: The back is carved with a star pattern, with the BRT mark in rose gold; the bail closes with a hinged catch.

/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/p01.title: A wide Cuban chain
/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/p01.text: A 20 mm Cuban chain in rose gold tones, every link densely paved with round diamonds, falling in a broad, even curve.

/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/p04.title: Dense pavé
/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/p04.text: Each link is covered edge to edge with round diamonds of several sizes, set so close that little metal shows.

/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/28-.title: Interlocking links
/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/28-.text: The links interlock at an angle, their paved tops rounded, with glimpses of polished rose gold between them.

/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/p05.title: The front of the curve
/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/p05.text: At the front, the chain lies flat and wide, every link turned the same way in a regular rhythm.

/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/p02.title: The domed clasp
/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/p02.text: The domed clasp is paved like the links, with the letters BRT and the outline of a diamond raised in polished gold.

/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/p03.title: The letters BRT
/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/p03.text: Close up, the polished letters stand above the pavé of the clasp, which closes with hinged tabs above and below.

/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/p06.title: The polished back
/media/hd/wide-rose-iced-cuban-chain/p06.text: Turned over, the chain shows its back in polished rose gold, each link a smooth curve of bright metal.

/media/pieces/marcus-thuram-thorned-t-pe.title: A T wound with thorns
/media/pieces/marcus-thuram-thorned-t-pe.text: Marcus Thuram's T pendant: a dripping T paved with white diamonds, wound from top to bottom with branches of rose gold thorns.

/media/stories/thuram-ss23/05.mp4.title: The T in motion
/media/stories/thuram-ss23/05.mp4.text: Hung against black fabric, the pendant sways gently, and the pavé sparkles between the polished rose gold thorns.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p22.w.title: A garden in coloured stones
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p22.w.text: A domed medallion where tulips, a cart and a small figure come to life in white diamonds and red, pink and blue stones, delivered in the Tulips on Tour case.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p21.w.title: The scene in relief
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p21.w.text: Seen at an angle, the scene rises in layers above the diamond ground, and the edge of the medallion reveals its band of red stones.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/v02.m.title: From bail to back
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/v02.m.text: The camera glides over the bail and its pear diamonds, the pink and green tulips, then the engraved back, where the figure and its cart pass the houses.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p16.w.title: The figure, up close
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p16.w.text: Cap and jacket in red stones, trousers in blue stones, face and shoes in polished white gold; small diamonds mark the buttons and the cuff.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p19.w.title: Petals in the air
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p19.w.text: Pink stones shaped like falling petals drift across the diamond ground, from the tulips towards the figure’s red cap, beneath the rose gold script.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p23.w.title: A bail of mixed cuts
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p23.w.text: The bail mixes baguettes, round diamonds and pairs of pear diamonds in fine bezels, laid out like a pattern from top to bottom.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p20.w.title: The bail in profile
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p20.w.text: Seen from the side, the bail is set with diamonds along its edge too, and each pear diamond stands slightly proud in its own bezel.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p18.w.title: Tulips above the cart
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p18.w.text: Pink stones form the tulip heads and green marquise stones their leaves; below, the cart is striped with red stones and baguettes.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p13.w.title: The script and the border
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p13.w.text: The rose gold script rests on a row of pear diamonds, inside a border of baguettes that follows the curve of the medallion.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p08.w.title: Flowers on a diamond grid
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p08.w.text: Behind the tulips, square diamonds are set edge to edge in a grid, lifting the flowers from the surface of the medallion.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p07.w.title: A single tulip
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p07.w.text: Each tulip pairs smooth, polished pink stones for the petals with faceted green marquise stones for the leaves, all held in fine bezels.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p12.w.title: A wheel of baguettes
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p12.w.text: The spokes of the wheel are baguettes meeting at a round diamond in the hub; the rim is set with round diamonds turned point outward.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p10.w.title: The wheel beside the figure
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p10.w.text: Open between its spokes, the wheel lets the diamond ground show through and stands out against the baguette border at the edge.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p15.w.title: A red drop among pears
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p15.w.text: Along the right edge, a row of pear diamonds follows the baguette border, and a red pear-shaped stone takes the place of one of them.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p11.w.title: The ground beneath the cart
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p11.w.text: Under the cart, round diamonds give way to a row of pear diamonds, with a red pear-shaped stone at the centre, just above the baguette border.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p05.w.title: An edge of red stones
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p05.w.text: The band around the medallion is set as well, with red stones scattered among round diamonds across its whole width.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p09.w.title: Baguettes in a zigzag
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p09.w.text: Between two polished rims, a line of baguettes zigzags along the edge, like a path through the red stones and diamonds.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p06.w.title: Houses on the back
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p06.w.text: The back is engraved with gabled houses, a street lamp and birds; the figure and its cart of tulips stand in relief above the BRT mark in rose gold.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p04.w.title: Resting in its case
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p04.w.text: The medallion lies in a bed of red velvet cut to its shape, inside a case lined with rows of printed tulips.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p02.w.title: The Tulips on Tour case
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p02.w.text: The case takes up the scene from the back of the medallion, with gabled houses, a bridge and the figure with its cart of tulips, framed in burgundy leather.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p03.w.title: The case and its tray
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p03.w.text: Beside the trunk stands the tray that holds the medallion, its dark lining printed with tulips around a cut-out of red velvet.

/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p01.w.title: Leather, studs and rose gold
/media/hd/tulips-on-tour-medallion/p01.w.text: Cream leather, studded burgundy trim, and corners and clasp in a rose gold tone: closed, the case looks like a small travel trunk.

/media/stories/collectors/54.mp4.title: Worn for the first time
/media/stories/collectors/54.mp4.text: Worn for the first time on its tennis chain, the medallion is lifted and turned in the hand, its colours flashing under the lights.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.title: Marcus Thuram’s gothic T
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.text: Marcus Thuram’s necklace: a large gothic T in baguettes with rose gold scrolls opens onto a drop of infinity links ending in a red pear-shaped stone.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.title: The whole necklace
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.text: On black velvet, the necklace shows its full line: diamond links shaped like infinity knots, gothic T stations along each side and the drop at the centre.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.title: Baguettes in a chevron
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.text: The T is paved with baguettes laid in a chevron pattern, with a line of round diamonds down the stem and a polished white gold outline.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.title: The T, edge to edge
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.text: A row of baguettes follows every angle of the letter, from the pointed arms to the tip of the stem, framing the woven centre.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.title: A scroll in rose gold
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.text: On each arm of the T, a sculpted rose gold scroll holds a pear diamond in a bezel, warm against the white gold and baguettes.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.title: Where T and chain meet
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.text: The arm of the T joins the infinity links; the scroll curls around pear diamonds, and a marquise diamond in rose gold sits on the next link.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.title: The stem in relief
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.text: Seen at an angle, the stem reveals its depth: the chevron of baguettes sits below a raised polished border and an outer row of baguettes.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.title: A T along the chain
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.text: On the T stations along the chain, marquise diamonds in rose gold bezels run down the stem, between a pear diamond and a round one.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.title: Infinity links
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.text: Each link is shaped like an infinity knot paved with round diamonds, joined by a small cross of baguettes; pear and marquise diamonds in rose gold mark the crossings.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.title: The drop, link by link
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.text: Hung straight, the drop alternates infinity knots in pavé and baguette connectors, with small pointed flares of diamonds on either side of each knot.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.title: The red pear
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.text: At the end of the drop, a large red pear-shaped stone is held by claws, framed in diamonds that flow into the last infinity knot.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.title: The BRT clasp
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-ruby-t-necklace/.text: The clasp carries the BRT mark in rose gold, its letters and diamond outline raised over a bed of pavé within a border of round diamonds.

/media/stories/thuram/13.mp4.title: In a gloved hand
/media/stories/thuram/13.mp4.text: In bright light, the camera follows the necklace from the clasp along the T stations, down to the large T and the red stone resting in a gloved hand.

/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.title: An initial under the stars
/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.text: A large round medallion in rose gold tones: the N and the 14 woven in baguettes, under an openwork web of stars, framed by marquise-cut diamonds.

/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p1.title: The whole medallion
/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p1.text: Laid flat, the medallion shows its full composition: the sculpted figure on the left, waves of diamonds in white gold below, and the bail crowned with a marquise flower.

/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/v0.title: In the palm
/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/v0.text: Held in an open hand, the medallion tilts slowly to show its depth, then turns back to face the light.

/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.title: A woven N
/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.text: The N is set with baguettes laid in a woven pattern and outlined in rose gold, with sculpted flames rising around it and stars above.

/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.title: The number in baguettes
/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.text: The 14 is built from small baguettes within a rose gold outline, set into sculpted gold and edged by the border of marquise diamonds.

/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.title: The figure and its waves
/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.text: A figure sculpted in rose gold tips a vessel forward, and from it a stream of diamonds in white gold pours down into waves.

/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.title: A web of stars
/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.text: Above the letters, fine rose gold wires radiate from round diamonds in bezels, an openwork web laid over a bed of smaller diamonds.

/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.title: The edge in profile
/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.text: In profile, the marquise diamonds stand proud in their rose gold bezels, and the edge of the medallion is paved with round diamonds as well.

/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.title: A marquise flower
/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.text: The bail is crowned with a flower of marquise diamonds, above a motif of baguettes framed in rose gold, on a ground of round diamonds.

/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.title: The bail at an angle
/media/hd/celestial-initial-medallion/p0.text: Seen at an angle, the bail rises from the top of the border, its rounded sides in pavé sloping down to where it joins the medallion.

/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p06.we.title: A crown of red flowers
/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p06.we.text: A Jesus piece in white gold tones, entirely paved with diamonds and crowned with flowers of red pear-shaped stones in rose gold settings.

/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p04.we.title: The crown and the gaze
/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p04.we.text: Beneath the rose gold crown, each eye is a round diamond in a bezel, standing out from the pavé that covers the face.

/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p01.we.title: The beard in pavé
/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p01.we.text: Fine lines of polished white gold trace the curls of the beard and the locks of hair through the pavé, catching the light like strands.

/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p02.we.title: Baguettes in the hair
/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p02.we.text: Baguettes are set here and there along the flowing locks, each in its own setting, breaking the pavé with straight flashes of light.

/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p07.we.title: A flower of red pears
/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p07.we.text: Each flower gathers red pear-shaped stones in rose gold bezels, set on branches of polished rose gold with small thorns.

/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p03.we.title: The locks in profile
/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p03.we.text: From the side, the hair falls in rounded waves of diamonds, each lock outlined by a polished white gold edge.

/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p05.we.title: The back, signed BRT
/media/hd/jesus-piece-red-flowers/p05.we.text: The back is carved with a star pattern, with the BRT mark in rose gold at its centre, below a polished bail.

/media/pieces/malik-tillman-tm-pendant/c.title: Initials for Malik Tillman
/media/pieces/malik-tillman-tm-pendant/c.text: Malik Tillman’s initials in gothic letters, the T set over the M, both set with diamonds and worn on a diamond-set Cuban chain in rose gold.

/media/stories/malik-tillman-ii/04.webp.title: Held up to the light
/media/stories/malik-tillman-ii/04.webp.text: Held in a gloved hand, the pendant shows its two tones: large claw-set diamonds along the letters in rose gold, framed by a border of white pavé.

/media/stories/malik-tillman-ii/01.webp.title: Welcome to the family
/media/stories/malik-tillman-ii/01.webp.text: Shared by the house to welcome Malik Tillman to the Berete family, the pendant stands on marble, its pointed gothic ends reflected below.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p16.title: A jersey, arms crossed
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p16.text: Noah Okafor's jersey, sculpted in volume and set stone by stone, arms crossed like its owner on the pitch.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p20.title: On a chain of flowers
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p20.text: The jersey hangs from a rose gold chain of diamond flowers, each bloom drawn in marquise and pear stones.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p17.title: The relief of the chest
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p17.text: Turned slightly, the jersey shows its relief: shoulder seams lined with green stones, arms in rose gold pavé folded across the body.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p02.title: On the bust
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p02.text: On a black bust, the chain falls in long lines of flowers on either side and sets the jersey at the centre of the chest.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/v01.title: From diamonds to the player
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/v01.text: Diamond by diamond, the jersey gives way to the player himself, standing in black and white in the very same pose.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p10.title: Neck and collar
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p10.text: The neck rises in rose gold pavé from a collar of white diamonds, the colours divided by a fine polished line.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p18.title: The Swiss cross
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p18.text: On the chest, a shield of red stones laid edge to edge and framed in rose gold carries a white cross of baguette diamonds.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p15.title: The sleeve band
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p15.text: Around the sleeve runs a band of green and white baguettes; above it, hexagonal diamonds and lines of green stones climb to the shoulder.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p11.title: A honeycomb of stones
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p11.text: On the shoulder, hexagonal diamonds fit together like a honeycomb, crossed by a polished white gold seam and a line of green stones.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p13.title: Arms above the base
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p13.text: Below the rose gold arms, the base begins: triangle-cut stones in raised white gold frames, set among pear and round diamonds.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p12.title: Triangle-cut stones
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p12.text: Each triangle-cut stone sits in its own white gold frame, the frames joining into small pyramids among flowers of marquise and pear diamonds.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p03.title: The chain, seen from behind
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p03.text: Behind the flowers, the links are polished rose gold, sculpted in smooth curves and pointed leaves, with touches of pavé at the joints.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p06.title: The back of the jersey
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p06.text: Turned around, the jersey carries OKA and the number 4 in baguette diamonds outlined in rose gold, with a crown set between them.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p09.title: Name and number
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p09.text: The letters OKA end in pointed stones, and beneath them a crown of rose gold pavé rests on top of the 4.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p07.title: OKA and the 4
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p07.text: Name and number stand out from a background of round, pear and marquise diamonds gathered into small flowers.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p05.title: A woven number
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p05.text: Inside the 4, baguettes are laid in alternating directions, like a weave, within a fine rose gold outline.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p04.title: The crown
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p04.text: The crown is paved in rose gold around a larger round diamond, each of its points ending in a small set star.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p01.title: Worn by Noah Okafor
/media/hd/noah-okafor-jersey-pendant/p01.text: Worn by Noah Okafor over black, the jersey sits at the chest, the Swiss cross and the green and white band catching the light.

/media/stories/noah-okafor/11.mp4.title: The same crossed arms
/media/stories/noah-okafor/11.mp4.text: In this short film, the crossed arms of the pendant and those of the player line up exactly, as the diamond jersey and his match shirt merge.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p05.we.title: OKA, in diamonds
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p05.we.text: Noah Okafor's nameplate: the letters OKA in white diamonds, crossed by rose gold patches, with a football in rose gold set on the K.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p17.we.title: On its Cuban chain
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p17.we.text: The pendant hangs from a diamond-set Cuban chain whose links alternate white and rose gold, each lined with baguettes.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p08.we.title: The bail, set in baguettes
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p08.we.text: The bail is set with baguettes framed by round diamonds, and passes through the chain like one more link.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p10.we.title: The bail from below
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p10.we.text: Seen from below, the bail reveals its polished white gold side, rising above the ball and the diamond-edged letters.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p14.we.title: The ball in focus
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p14.we.text: Sharp against the blurred letters, the rose gold ball stands out in relief, its panels polished like mirrors.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p03.we.title: The ball
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p03.we.text: A football sculpted in rose gold, its panels traced by fine grooves, sits in a ring of diamonds on the K.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p04.we.title: Patches of rose gold
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p04.we.text: Polished rose gold patches with irregular edges cross the letters, laid over a bed of round diamonds.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p09.we.title: The letters in depth
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p09.we.text: From the side, the letters reveal their depth, round diamonds edging both their face and their flank.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p06.we.title: The letter O
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p06.we.text: Inside the O, baguettes are laid on the diagonal in a close lattice, beneath raised patches of rose gold.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p16.we.title: A lattice of baguettes
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p16.we.text: Up close, the baguettes of the O catch the light one by one, between the polished curves of the rose gold patches.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p07.we.title: The letter A
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p07.we.text: The A repeats the same play of baguettes and rose gold, beside the ball and its halo of diamonds.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p13.we.title: Set to the edge
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p13.we.text: The flanks of the letters are paved too, with round diamonds set right up to the polished edge.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p01.we.title: Worn by Noah Okafor
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p01.we.text: Worn by Noah Okafor at night, the nameplate sits at the chest over a plain T-shirt, on its Cuban chain of white and rose gold.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p02.we.title: Over a white shirt
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p02.we.text: Worn over a white T-shirt, the nameplate hangs just below the collar, its rose gold patches warmed by the light.

/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p18.we.title: In its case
/media/hd/noah-okafor-oka-pendant/p18.we.text: Presented in its black case, the chain is laid in a loop above the nameplate, its clasp at the top.

/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p10.webp.title: A letter and an angel
/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p10.webp.text: Deniz Undav's pendant: a tall letter L paved with white diamonds, with a cherub in rose gold resting in its corner.

/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p08.webp.title: The angel in profile
/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p08.webp.text: At an angle, the cherub's satin rose gold stands against the pavé, and the bail shows its polished inner side.

/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p04.webp.title: A sleeping cherub
/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p04.webp.text: Eyes closed, head resting on folded arms, the cherub is sculpted in satin rose gold, each feather of its wing drawn one by one.

/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p09.webp.title: The flank of the letter
/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p09.webp.text: Seen from the side, the stem of the L is paved on its flank too, edged with a fine line of polished white gold.

/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p07.webp.title: Light across the pavé
/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p07.webp.text: Under a raking light, the pavé of round diamonds in different sizes runs to the edge, where the cherub's wing begins.

/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p03.webp.title: The foot of the L
/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p03.webp.text: The foot of the letter is set as fully as the stem, its diamonds following every corner of the block.

/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p06.webp.title: The bail, set in rows
/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p06.webp.text: Its bail is set with diamonds too, in rows of round stones, with polished white gold on the inside.

/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p01.webp.title: The BRT mark
/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p01.webp.text: On the back, the BRT mark in rose gold stands in relief on the engraved pattern, beneath the polished hinge of the bail.

/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p05.webp.title: The stem in pavé
/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p05.webp.text: Along the stem, larger and smaller diamonds are set close together, leaving almost no metal to be seen.

/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p02.webp.title: An engraved back
/media/hd/deniz-undav-l-pendant/p02.webp.text: The whole back is engraved with a pattern of interlaced circles, signed with the BRT mark in rose gold.

/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p01.webp.title: Cuban links in rose gold
/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p01.webp.text: A 14 mm Cuban chain in rose gold tones, every link paved with round diamonds, on a black bust.

/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p02.webp.title: Around the neck
/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p02.webp.text: From the front, the chain closes around the neck in an even line, its links lying flat against one another.

/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p05.webp.title: Link by link
/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p05.webp.text: Each link is paved with round diamonds of different sizes, held by fine rose gold prongs.

/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p04.webp.title: At eye level
/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p04.webp.text: Seen at eye level, the links show their curve, the diamonds following the rounded surface right to the edge.

/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p06.webp.title: Interlocking links
/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p06.webp.text: Up close, the links fit into one another, rose gold showing only in the gaps between the pavé.

/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p03.webp.title: The clasp, signed BRT
/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p03.webp.text: The flat clasp is set with diamonds around the BRT mark, drawn in polished rose gold beside the outline of a diamond.

/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p07.webp.title: Polished on the back
/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p07.webp.text: On the back, each link is polished rose gold, smooth and bare, the reverse of the pavé on the front.

/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p08.webp.title: The back of the clasp
/media/hd/rose-iced-cuban-chain/p08.webp.text: Behind, the clasp is a plain block of polished rose gold, with a small tab on its upper edge.

/media/pieces/jamie-leweling-jl-pendant/.title: J and L
/media/pieces/jamie-leweling-jl-pendant/.text: Jamie Leweling's initials: the J and the L filled with baguette-cut diamonds, outlined with round stones and a fine rose gold edge.

/media/stories/jamie-leweling/02.webp.title: Worn by Jamie Leweling
/media/stories/jamie-leweling/02.webp.text: Worn by Jamie Leweling, the JL pendant hangs on its chain beside the ribbons of his DFB-Pokal medal.

/media/stories/collectors/07.webp.title: On a fine chain
/media/stories/collectors/07.webp.text: Jamie Leweling wears his initials on a fine white gold chain over a dark sweatshirt, the baguettes catching the daylight.

/media/pieces/tajon-buchanan-iced-watch/.title: A square watch, fully set
/media/pieces/tajon-buchanan-iced-watch/.text: Tajon Buchanan's square watch, with Roman numerals, its case, dial and bracelet set with diamonds from edge to edge.

/media/stories/tajon-buchanan/03.webp.title: At the house
/media/stories/tajon-buchanan/03.webp.text: Tajon Buchanan at the house, standing beneath the BRT sign with a black BRT bag in hand.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: A letter and its serpent
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: Made for Marcus Thuram: a gothic T of white diamonds and baguettes, wrapped by a rose gold serpent whose eye is a red pear-shaped stone.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: The letter, face on
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: Face on, the serpent loops around the stem of the T, its head resting against the letter and its tail sweeping out beneath the lower spur.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: Reflected on black
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: Standing on a black mirror, the pendant doubles in its reflection; the white of the T and the rose gold of the serpent stay clearly apart.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: The depth of the letter
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: Turned to the side, the T reveals its depth: high walls of polished white gold carry the diamonds, while the serpent stands out in relief.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: In gloved hands
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: Held between gloved hands, the pendant tilts gently; the diamonds of the T flicker and the red eye of the serpent catches the light.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: The coil around the stem
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: The serpent passes behind the stem and comes back in front of it, so the letter seems held in its coil.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: Round diamonds, baguette edges
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: Down the stem, round diamonds in pavé fill the centre, and a row of baguettes runs along each edge, sharpening the outline of the letter.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: The setting, up close
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: Up close, the rose gold rims around the serpent’s diamonds press against the white gold pavé of the stem, warm metal beside cool.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: The scales, pear by pear
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: Its scales are pear-shaped diamonds, each in its own rose gold setting, laid in overlapping rows along the curve of the body.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: Where body meets letter
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: The serpent’s body sweeps under the spur of the stem; in this close focus, each pear-shaped scale throws back its own point of light.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: The eye
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: The serpent’s eye is a large red pear-shaped stone, held in a thin rose gold rim and circled by a border of small round diamonds.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: The gothic arm
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: The right arm of the crossbar drops into a gothic point, its pavé framed by baguettes that taper with the outline down to the tip.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: Baguettes along the edge
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: On the left arm, baguettes line every edge of the gothic outline, while round diamonds of several sizes fill the surface in pavé.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: The tip and the tail
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: At the foot of the letter, the spur is framed in baguettes around a cluster of round diamonds, and the serpent’s tail curls just beneath it.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: Where bar meets stem
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: Where the crossbar meets the stem, round diamonds of varied sizes gather, edged along the top by a single straight line of baguettes.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: A bail in pavé
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: The bail tapers towards the letter and is paved with round diamonds, set so closely that the metal almost disappears.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: The polished side
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: Along the edge, slim diamonds with pointed tips follow the gothic outline, above a side wall of white gold polished to a mirror.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: The crossbar in profile
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: From the side, the crossbar stands on a smooth white gold wall, the diamonds lining its rim like a crest above the rose gold serpent.

/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.title: The bail and the back
/media/hd/marcus-thuram-t-serpent-pendan.text: On the reverse, the polished bail shows its hinge and small latch, above a back carved all over with a geometric star pattern.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: The hero and the dragon
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: Made for Kevin Schade, a sculpture in miniature: a rose gold hero lifts a sphere of blue stones while a diamond dragon coils around him.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: Seen from the front
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: From the front, the dragon winds through the whole piece, framing the hero among small rose gold spheres, each marked with stars.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: On the Cuban chain
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: On a black bust, the pendant hangs from its diamond-set Cuban chain, the broad links paved all around and leading down to the bail.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: Arms raised to the sphere
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: The hero is sculpted in rose gold with a satin finish, every muscle and lock of hair modelled, his arms raised to hold up the sphere.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: The blue sphere
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: The sphere is set with blue stones in many shades: round ones close together, crossed by baguettes and squares set at angles.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: The dragon crosses the sphere
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: A coil of the dragon passes over the sphere: white diamonds in pavé, edged by a ridge of polished white gold that flows like a fin.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: Coils around the hero
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: Below the hero’s belt, the dragon’s coils cross and overlap, each paved with diamonds and finished with a polished, rippling edge.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: A sphere among the coils
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: Between the hero’s legs, a rose gold sphere rests among the coils, its polished surface carrying stars in relief.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: The dragon, up close
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: Up close, the dragon’s body is paved with round diamonds, while a crest of polished white gold ripples along its spine.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: Sharp forms, from the side
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: Seen from the side, pointed forms in pavé and polished white gold rise like flames around the rose gold spheres.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: Light on the pavé
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: Behind the hero’s raised arm, the diamond pavé is traced with fine lines of polished white gold that catch the light.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: A coil in sharp focus
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: In sharp focus, one coil of the dragon shows its round diamonds set side by side, between polished edges that ripple in the light.

/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.title: The back
/media/hd/kevin-schade-dragon-ball-penda.text: The back is carved with a geometric star pattern and carries the BRT mark in rose gold; on this side, the chain’s links are polished smooth.

/media/stories/kevin-schade/22.mp4.title: In a gloved hand
/media/stories/kevin-schade/22.mp4.text: Resting in a gloved hand, the pendant turns from side to side; as it moves, the blue sphere flashes pale under the light.

/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p12.web.title: Baguettes within a diamond border
/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p12.web.text: A cross in rose gold tones, filled with rows of baguette diamonds inside a border of round diamonds, beneath a bail set with baguettes.

/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p09.web.title: Laid at an angle
/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p09.web.text: Seen at a low angle, the cross shows the depth of its polished rose gold sides, its diamond face raised high above the black surface.

/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p04.web.title: A weave of baguettes
/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p04.web.text: Inside, the baguettes are laid in small groups that change direction, like a woven pattern, so the surface catches light in alternating blocks.

/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p05.web.title: The heart of the cross
/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p05.web.text: At the crossing, the woven baguettes run from one arm to the next, framed by a single line of round diamonds that follows every corner.

/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p11.web.title: Beneath the bail
/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p11.web.text: Under the bail, the upper arm leads down to the crossing; the round diamonds of the border sit in fine rose gold claws.

/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p08.web.title: The end of an arm
/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p08.web.text: At the end of an arm, the border turns square around the baguettes, each round diamond raised on its own rose gold claws.

/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p10.web.title: The bail, set with baguettes
/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p10.web.text: The bail carries a line of baguettes flanked on each side by round diamonds, its inner face left in polished rose gold.

/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p07.web.title: The bail joins the cross
/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p07.web.text: Seen from the side, the bail shows its square, open profile, rising straight from the top arm of the cross.

/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p03.web.title: The carved back
/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p03.web.text: The back is carved with a star pattern in rose gold, running along every arm, with the BRT mark at the crossing.

/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p02.web.title: The reverse, whole
/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p02.web.text: Turned over, the cross is carved from edge to edge, and the bail at the top shows its hinge and small latch.

/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p01.web.title: The BRT mark
/media/hd/baguette-cross-pendant/p01.web.text: At the crossing of the back, the BRT mark and its diamond outline are engraved among the stars of the carved pattern.

/media/hd/the-hand/p07.webp.title: A hand in rose gold
/media/hd/the-hand/p07.webp.text: A hand sculpted in volume, then set stone by stone with diamonds; it hangs from a bail lit by a single oval red stone.

/media/hd/the-hand/p02.webp.title: In profile
/media/hd/the-hand/p02.webp.text: Lying on its side, the hand shows its curled fingers with nails in polished rose gold, and beyond them the bail with its red stone.

/media/hd/the-hand/p01.webp.title: Set stone by stone
/media/hd/the-hand/p01.webp.text: Thumb and finger meet, their nails in polished rose gold, while round diamonds in pavé follow every curve of the hand.

/media/hd/the-hand/p06.webp.title: The wrist
/media/hd/the-hand/p06.webp.text: At the wrist, a band of baguette and step-cut diamonds is framed above and below by polished rose gold, like a cuff.

/media/hd/the-hand/p03.webp.title: From above
/media/hd/the-hand/p03.webp.text: From above, the back of the piece is left in smooth, polished rose gold, the pavé showing only along its edges.

/media/hd/the-hand/p05.webp.title: The BRT mark
/media/hd/the-hand/p05.webp.text: The BRT mark is engraved on the flat end of the wrist, a polished rose gold disc framed by the band of diamonds.

/media/hd/the-hand/p04.webp.title: Between gloved fingers
/media/hd/the-hand/p04.webp.text: Held at the wrist between gloved fingers, the hand points downward, and the bail with its oval red stone hangs from its fingertip.

/media/stories/eljero-elia/04.webp.title: A clover at the heart
/media/stories/eljero-elia/04.webp.text: Made for Eljero Elia, a round medallion in yellow gold tones, with a raised border of diamonds and a four-leaf clover paved at its centre.

/media/stories/eljero-elia/05.webp.title: In profile
