/media/stories/eljero-elia/05.webp.text: In profile, rows of round diamonds line the outer edge of the border, with the clover set slightly back inside the frame.

/media/stories/eljero-elia/06.mp4.title: Around the medallion
/media/stories/eljero-elia/06.mp4.text: The camera moves slowly around the medallion on a dark stand, from the paved border to the clover, its leaves raised in relief.

/media/stories/eljero-elia/02.mp4.title: The centre turns
/media/stories/eljero-elia/02.mp4.text: A touch of the finger sets the centre spinning: the clover blurs into a disc of light, then slows until its leaves appear again.

/media/stories/eljero-elia/03.webp.title: The border
/media/stories/eljero-elia/03.webp.text: Up close, the raised border holds its round diamonds in yellow gold claws, and the pavé of the centre glitters just beyond.

/media/stories/collectors/06.webp.title: Worn by Eljero Elia
/media/stories/collectors/06.webp.text: Eljero Elia wears the medallion on a yellow gold chain set with diamonds, the clover resting at the centre of his chest.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.title: A cross for Malik Tillman
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.text: Malik Tillman's cross in round and baguette diamonds, hanging from a diamond-shaped bail on a chunky diamond link chain.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.title: On the bust
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.text: On a black bust, the link chain frames the neck and the cross falls to the centre of the chest, its diamond-shaped bail just above.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.title: The diamond-shaped bail
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.text: The bail is a square set on its point: a pavé frame around baguettes laid like a weave, with a small cross of baguettes at its heart.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.title: The monogram at the heart
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.text: At the crossing, a monogram in polished white gold rises from a disc paved with diamonds, edged with its own border of small stones.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.title: Polished letters, set stones
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.text: Close up, the smooth relief of the monogram contrasts with the diamonds around it, each round stone held in its own polished bezel.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.title: Round and baguette
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.text: One arm of the cross: round diamonds of several sizes in bezel settings, framed by a line of pavé and a border of baguettes.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.title: The end of an arm
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.text: At the tip of an arm, the baguette frame turns the corner, and haloed round diamonds follow the outline like a scalloped edge.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.title: The frame in relief
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.text: Seen at an angle, the baguettes line the bevelled sides of the frame, and the haloed diamonds of the border rise above the black velvet.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.title: Where the arms meet
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.text: In the inner corner between two arms, the haloed diamonds of the border turn at a right angle, close against the baguette frame.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.title: The long edge
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.text: Along the lower arm, the haloed diamonds line up one after another, beside a frame of pavé and baguettes that encloses the bezel-set centre.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.title: A field of round diamonds
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.text: The length of the cross is filled with round diamonds of different sizes, each in its own bezel, fitted closely together like bubbles.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.title: Baguettes on the slope
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.text: From the side, the frame shows its depth: a sloping wall of baguettes between two fine lines of pavé.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.title: Crosses in the chain
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.text: The chain alternates rings paved with diamonds and bars of baguettes; where they meet, a small cross of baguettes echoes the pendant.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.title: A cross in white gold
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p1.text: Closer still, a small cross of baguettes sits in a polished white gold setting, between two rings densely paved with round diamonds.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.title: The clasp and its mark
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.text: The clasp is a domed oval of pavé around baguettes, bearing the BRT mark in rose gold, with its catch on the side.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.title: The back of the cross
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.text: On the back, the white gold is engraved with a repeating star pattern, and the BRT mark is set in rose gold at the centre.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.title: The BRT mark
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.text: The signature of the house, close up: the letters BRT and the outline of a diamond, in rose gold, raised on the engraved white gold.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.title: The chain from behind
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.text: Turned over, the chain reveals polished white gold: double-loop links joined by smooth, flat bars.

/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.title: The cross, worn
/media/hd/malik-tillman-cross-pendant/p0.text: Worn, the cross sits at the centre of the chest, the chain close around the neck, its diamonds catching the light against dark clothing.

/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p21.title: A name in diamonds
/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p21.text: Loïs Openda's pendant: a name in script letters, paved with diamonds and outlined in polished rose gold, with a cross of baguettes in its first letter.

/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p03.title: On the Cross Infinity chain
/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p03.text: On a black bust, the pendant hangs from the Cross Infinity chain: round links paved with diamonds, joined by crosses of baguettes.

/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p15.title: The letters in relief
/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p15.text: At an angle, the letters stand out in relief above a domed base of pavé, their polished rose gold outlines catching the light.

/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p20.title: Marquise and pear
/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p20.text: Marquise and pear-shaped diamonds, held in rose gold claws, punctuate the curves of the first letter around its cross of baguettes.

/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p16.title: The edge in profile
/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p16.text: In profile, a band of baguettes runs around the edge between rows of round diamonds, and the back shows its engraved rose gold.

/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p17.title: Following the curves
/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p17.text: The band of baguettes follows every curve of the outline, while the polished letters stand above the pavé like a second layer.

/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p01.title: The cross in the first letter
/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p01.text: Inside the loop of the first letter, a cross of baguettes sits in a polished rose gold setting, surrounded by round diamonds of different sizes.

/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p13.title: Close to the cross
/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p13.text: Very close, the baguettes of the cross meet at its centre, and the rose gold walls of the letters rise around it.

/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p19.title: The final letters
/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p19.text: Towards the end of the name, the letters are traced in rose gold and set with round diamonds, with marquise and pear shapes in claws at their tips.

/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p14.title: Pavé and baguettes
/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p14.text: At the edge, rows of round diamonds in rose gold claws sit above the band of baguettes, beneath a letter outlined in polished gold.

/media/pieces/lois-openda-nameplate-pend.title: The script and its cross
/media/pieces/lois-openda-nameplate-pend.text: Each letter is traced by a fine line of polished rose gold, like a pen stroke, and the cross of baguettes sits where the first letter loops.

/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p18.title: The bail
/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p18.text: The bail is paved across its face with round diamonds; inside, it is polished rose gold, and it opens on a hinge to take the chain.

/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p12.title: Faith, on the back
/media/hd/lois-openda-script-pendant/p12.text: On the back, the rose gold is engraved with a star pattern, with the BRT mark in white gold above the word Faith, written in script.

/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p11..title: Two initials, one shield
/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p11..text: Angelo Stiller's pendant: his initials A and S drawn into a shield, set with baguette and round diamonds, beneath a bail paved with diamonds.

/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p07..title: On its tennis chain
/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p07..text: The shield hangs from a tennis chain of round diamonds, each held in claws, which passes through the paved bail.

/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p03..title: On the black bust
/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p03..text: On a black bust, the tennis chain draws a fine line of light, and the shield hangs at the centre of the chest.

/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p02..title: Turned to the side
/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p02..text: Turned on the bust, the pendant shows its engraved back and the BRT mark in rose gold, with diamonds paved along its edge.

/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/v02..title: Before the BRT sign
/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/v02..text: On a black bust turned slowly in front of the lit BRT sign of the house, the shield sways gently and the tennis chain sparkles.

/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p08..title: Baguettes in herringbone
/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p08..text: Tilted, the shield reveals its baguettes laid in a herringbone, between the round diamonds that draw the letters and the edge.

/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p04..title: The paved bail
/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p04..text: The bail is paved with rows of round diamonds and opens on a hinge to take the tennis chain.

/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p05..title: The letter A
/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p05..text: The letter A, outlined in round diamonds; its inner space and the gap beneath it are left open, so the black shows through.

/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p09..title: The bevelled edge
/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p09..text: Along the edge, the shield bends into a bevel paved with round diamonds, finished by a fine rim of white gold.

/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p01..title: The BRT mark, on the back
/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p01..text: The back is engraved with a star pattern, the BRT mark in rose gold at its centre, and the bail closes with a safety catch.

/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p10..title: In profile
/media/hd/angelo-stiller-as-pendant/p10..text: In profile, the shield shows its thickness: a paved side between the engraved back and the front, and a polished bail with its hinge.

/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.title: His celebration, in diamonds
/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.text: Kenan Yildiz's pendant: two hands crossed in the gesture of his goal celebration, sculpted in volume and paved with white diamonds, with baguettes at the cuffs.

/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.title: The bail and its stones
/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.text: From another angle, the bail appears as a paved drop with a band of baguettes and a cluster of step-cut stones, linked to the fingertips by a small ring.

/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.title: The BRT mark at the wrist
/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.text: In profile, one wrist ends in a polished disc engraved with the BRT mark; the back of the hand is satin-finished beside the paved fingers.

/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.title: KY at the other wrist
/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.text: The other wrist ends in a round medallion of polished white gold, engraved with his initials KY and a small star.

/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.title: The reverse, in satin
/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.text: From behind, the hands are in satin-finished white gold, with polished nails and cuffs, and a smooth drop-shaped bail.

/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.title: Light on the satin
/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.text: Turned to the light, the satin gold shows the sculpted knuckles and fingers, with a line of diamonds showing at their edges.

/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.title: Worn by Kenan Yildiz
/media/hd/kenan-yildiz-celebration-penda.text: Kenan Yildiz wears the pendant on a fine chain, the crossed hands resting at the centre of his chest.

/media/stories/kenan-yildiz/04.webp.title: Seen from above
/media/stories/kenan-yildiz/04.webp.text: Seen from above, the polished loop of the bail leads down to the medallion at the wrist, where satin gold meets the paved fingers.

/media/hd/the-safi-link/p06.webp.title: Flowers, link after link
/media/hd/the-safi-link/p06.webp.text: The Safi Link: a rose gold chain of flowers in marquise-cut diamonds, joined one to the next by curving links paved with diamonds.

/media/hd/the-safi-link/p07.webp.title: Around the neck
/media/hd/the-safi-link/p07.webp.text: On a black bust, the flowers alternate with sprays of marquise and pear-shaped diamonds, and the chain lies close around the neck like a collar.

/media/hd/the-safi-link/p03.webp.title: The flower
/media/hd/the-safi-link/p03.webp.text: Each flower gathers marquise and pear-shaped diamonds as petals, every stone circled by a halo of small diamonds in rose gold.

/media/hd/the-safi-link/p02.webp.title: A flower for a clasp
/media/hd/the-safi-link/p02.webp.text: The clasp is a flower too: marquise, pear and round diamonds in rose gold bezels around a pavé heart that carries the BRT mark.

/media/hd/the-safi-link/p04.webp.title: The reverse in rose gold
/media/hd/the-safi-link/p04.webp.text: Turned over, the chain shows its polished rose gold: sculpted links that twist between the flowers, the tips of the petals showing at the edges.

/media/hd/the-safi-link/p01.webp.title: From behind
/media/hd/the-safi-link/p01.webp.text: Seen from behind, the chain sits close at the nape, the flower of the clasp resting at the centre of the neck.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: A ring that opens
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: A championship ring for VfB Stuttgart, winners of the 2025 DFB-Pokal. Its removable top lifts off and reveals the cup, sculpted in rose gold.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: The crest at its heart
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: The enamelled club crest is framed by shield-cut red stones and baguettes, above a rose-gold script that reads “Furchtlos und treu”.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: Tier upon tier
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: Seen from above, the head rises in tiers: a rose-gold rim, a row of bezel-set diamonds, then pavé, with rose-gold stars studding its base.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: Atakan Karazor, number 16
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: Every ring carries the name and number of the player who wears it: here in rose-gold capitals, the number set between red stones on a field of baguettes.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: Deniz Undav, number 26
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: Above his name, VFB STUTTGART runs around the head in rose-gold letters, over a band of rose-gold stars, each with a red stone at its centre.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: Maximilian Mittelstädt, number 7
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: A border of round diamonds frames the panel around his name and number, then follows the shoulder down towards the band.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: Angelo Stiller, number 6
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: One design for the whole squad, made personal by each name. Inside, the band is polished smooth and catches the light.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: One ring per player
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: Created for the squad, the rings share one design: the crest at the centre, shield-cut red stones around it, the rose-gold rim.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: The squad, in a row
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: Lined up one behind the other, the rings recede into the dark, each crest catching the light in turn.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: The cup beneath
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: With the top removed, the DFB-Pokal appears, sculpted in rose gold on a polished white-gold disc, its bands and lettering in fine relief.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: DFB-Pokal 2025, in letters
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: The words DFB-Pokal 2025 run in rose gold around the head; below, the cup stands in relief on the side, above a thin stripe of red and yellow.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: In profile, the cup
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: From the side, the cup stands on the shoulder in polished rose gold, over a disc of pavé framed by baguettes.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: A trophy on the shoulder
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: Up close, the rose-gold cup carries a small engraved emblem, and above it the baguettes fill a panel that narrows towards the cup.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: Lettering around the head
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: Low and close, DFB-Pokal 2025 curves around the head between twisted borders, while the rose-gold stars follow its curve, each holding a red stone.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: Beside the trophy
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: Set down at the foot of the trophy itself, the rings echo in miniature the cup sculpted beneath their tops.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: Worn by the squad
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: On the hand of a player in the club’s colours, the ring shows its crest, its rose-gold rim and its red stones.

/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.title: Crest forward
/media/hd/vfb-stuttgart-dfb-pokal-2025/p.text: Held up crest forward by a player of the squad, the ring shows its full volume against the hand that wears it.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.title: A crown of red stones
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.text: A Jesus piece in rose gold tones, entirely paved with diamonds and crowned with thorns, red pear-shaped stones and sharp polished spikes.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.title: The face in relief
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.text: Turned slightly, the face shows its full relief, from the diamond eyes to the beard, beneath the tall bail that rises above the crown.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.title: The crown in profile
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.text: From the side, the diamond-lined branches of the crown wrap around the head, and the polished spikes reach outwards.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.title: Red stones above the eyes
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.text: Red pear-shaped stones sit in the crown above the brow; below, each eye is a round diamond in a rose-gold frame.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.title: Spikes in every direction
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.text: Seen at an angle, sharp spikes of polished rose gold point in every direction from the diamond-lined branches of the crown.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.title: Held by rose-gold claws
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.text: Each red pear is held by slim rose-gold claws, pointed like the thorns around it, between branches set with small diamonds.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.title: A cross on the bail
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.text: The tall bail carries a cross of diamonds over baguettes, with a single round diamond set at its centre.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.title: The bail, turned
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.text: In three-quarter view, the bail shows its depth: baguettes in rows on the front, polished rose gold on the sides and within.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.title: Above the crown
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.text: Tilted towards the light, the bail reveals its polished rose-gold interior, while the spikes of the crown fan out below.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.title: Lips of polished gold
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.text: Amid the pavé, the lips are left in polished gold, and fine rose-gold lines draw the strands of the beard.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.title: A mirror among diamonds
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.text: Close up, the polished lips reflect like a mirror, framed by a beard of diamonds divided by waves of rose gold.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.title: The hair, set point outward
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.text: The locks of hair are set with diamonds turned point outward, a sharper texture than the face, edged in polished rose gold.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.title: Light in the locks
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.text: Under the light, each stone of the hair opens into a star of facets, mirrored on the dark surface below.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.title: The back, carved
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.text: The back is carved with a pattern of stars and carries the BRT mark in white gold; the bail opens on a hinge and closes with a small catch.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.title: A pattern in the light
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p0.text: Laid at an angle, the carved stars catch the light across the back, while the diamond-set edge shows along its outline.

/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.title: Signed BRT
/media/hd/crown-of-thorns-jesus-piece/p1.text: The BRT mark and the outline of a diamond, in white gold, stand in relief on the carved rose gold of the back.

/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p04.webp.title: Flowers along the links
/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p04.webp.text: A chain of twisted links in rose gold tones, paved with diamonds, with flowers of round diamonds and leaves of marquise-cut diamonds along its length.

/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p05.webp.title: Following the neck
/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p05.webp.text: On the bust, the chain follows the line of the neck, polished links alternating with paved ones, a flower at regular intervals.

/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p12.webp.title: Polished and paved
/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p12.webp.text: Each polished rose-gold link twists through a link paved with diamonds, and the flowers rest on the polished curves.

/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p15.webp.title: Anatomy of a flower
/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p15.webp.text: At the heart of each flower, a round diamond in a rose-gold bezel; around it, petals of round diamonds, each in its own rim.

/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p07.webp.title: Leaves of marquise diamonds
/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p07.webp.text: Marquise-cut diamonds, each in a thin rose-gold bezel, grow from the links like leaves on a stem.

/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p06.webp.title: The rhythm of the chain
/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p06.webp.text: Flower, polished link, paved link, leaves: the same sequence repeats along the chain, each element catching the light at its own angle.

/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p11.webp.title: A clasp signed BRT
/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p11.webp.text: The rectangular clasp is paved with diamonds around the BRT mark and the outline of a diamond in rose gold, within a raised border of diamonds.

/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p14.webp.title: The mark, in relief
/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p14.webp.text: Up close, the letters and the openwork diamond stand above the pavé, letting the stones beneath show through.

/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p13.webp.title: A twist of light
/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p13.webp.text: A paved link curves through a polished one, the mirror finish of the gold reflecting the diamonds beside it.

/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p02.webp.title: Leaves at the edge
/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p02.webp.text: In soft focus, a paved link rests between polished curves, with marquise leaves rising from its edges.

/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p03.webp.title: The clasp from behind
/media/hd/brt-flower-chain/p03.webp.text: Seen from the back, the clasp is polished smooth, and the links show their polished rose gold.

/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p05..title: Thorns and roses
/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p05..text: A cross paved with baguette diamonds carries a Christ sculpted in rose gold, wound with a thorny vine and sculpted roses.

/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p04..title: Satin and polish
/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p04..text: The Christ and the roses have a soft satin finish, while the thorny vine is polished bright as it winds around the arm.

/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p07..title: Roses up the bail
/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p07..text: Roses and thorns climb the bail, which is paved with baguettes on the front and polished white gold on its side.

/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p01..title: The face of Christ
/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p01..text: Beneath a crown of thorns, the face and beard are sculpted in fine detail; the vine wraps the waist and the outstretched arm.

/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p03..title: The foot of the cross
/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p03..text: The vine winds around the feet and down the cross to a cluster of roses, over rows of baguettes.

/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p02..title: Roses in reflection
/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p02..text: At the foot, sculpted roses and thorns stand over the baguettes, mirrored with them in the dark surface below.

/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p06..title: The back, in stars
/media/hd/thorns-and-roses-crucifix/p06..text: The back is carved with a star pattern and carries the BRT mark in rose gold; above, the bail opens on a hinge.

/media/pieces/tanguy-nianzou-fam-medalli.title: Family first
/media/pieces/tanguy-nianzou-fam-medalli.text: Tanguy Nianzou’s FAM medallion: round and paved with diamonds, its edge ribbed like a coin, hanging from a diamond-set Cuban chain.

/media/stories/nz/06.webp.title: Among the roses
/media/stories/nz/06.webp.text: Rose-gold roses and engraved leaves grow along slender branches, with marquise-cut diamonds set in the flowers.

/media/stories/nz/02.webp.title: One for each member
/media/stories/nz/02.webp.text: The word FAM rises in polished letters among the roses; each marquise-cut diamond stands for a member of the family.

/media/stories/nz/05.mp4.title: Around the bust
/media/stories/nz/05.mp4.text: The film moves around the bust: the medallion turns from front to profile and back, showing the relief of the letters and its ribbed edge.

/media/pieces/marcus-thuram-skeleton-wat.title: An open dial in diamonds
/media/pieces/marcus-thuram-skeleton-wat.text: A square watch with a skeleton dial, its case and bracelet entirely set with diamonds, the numerals paved too, shown with a Cuban chain.
